name: upstream-syntax-reasoning-dataflow-boundary

checks.name: syntax parsing has its own closed upstream contract
syntax parser owns lexical tokenization and method parsing
syntax parser returns typed syntax evidence without semantic capability classification
semantic producer consumes parsed syntax rather than lexing or parsing methods itself
semantic producer retains semantic origin and expression/assignment/property production
syntax contract is exported from upstream type surface
AST dataflow aliases are owned by the canonical semantic interface
legacy AST dataflow path is compatibility-only, not a production import
runtime dataflow projection does not invoke semantic reasoning
reachability closure remains owned by upstream authority
phase 1408 audit is wired into package scripts without changing package identity
phase 1409 audit is wired into package scripts

residuals: Source syntax parsing is now separated from semantic product construction, but the syntax parser still uses the existing PHP lexer and method/property parser implementations rather than a full language-neutral parser port.

The semantic producer still assigns semantic origin from source-family and owner context; that reasoning should eventually be represented as a source-family capability/judgment upstream of AST projection.
Other Laravel source families are still produced through their existing scanner paths and have not all been migrated onto the same evidence/parse/semantic contract pipeline.

The parser runtime smoke test is blocked during module initialization by a pre-existing ReferenceError: relationRuleEntries is not defined in packages/core/src/compiler/scanner/subscanners/queryEvidenceProducer.ts; trace and repair that relation catalog/import boundary before claiming runtime execution.
Full TypeScript build and integration tests require the repository dependency toolchain, which must be verified in the target workspace.
flow: Laravel source -> SourceAstEvidenceAcquisitionInterface -> SourceAstSyntaxParserInterface -> syntax AST -> semantic producer/reasoning -> closed AST/ADT and dataflow judgment -> wiring -> runtime executor -> manifest/graph/IR/CLI/SDK/React
